completion:
# Instructions for accurately documenting passed building fire-safety checks

## Step 1: Locate the completed fire-safety check
1. Open the fire-safety check in your phone.
2. Use the camera to open the pre-recorded video of the inspection.
3. Locate the “user feedback” page.
4. Take a screenshot of the completed inspection form, ensuring that it includes the user’s signature.

## Step 2: Capture the completed inspection form

1.) Select the “Screenshot” button on the user’s phone.
2.) Press the screenshot button.

The screenshot will automatically be saved to the user’s phone.

If the user is unable to capture the screenshot, consult the instructions found at the end of the “user feedback” page.

The instructions are also available by selecting the “user feedback” tab on the phone’s home screen.
3. পরবর্তী পদক্ষেপ
